title: The Warning Signal: The AI Bubble TOP.
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Per WSJ, a bubble ends when companies can no longer raise money to survive; that funding window is still open, so the party continues.
Microsoft plus Nvidia alone match dot-com bubble share of the market.
Anthropic/OpenAI IPO delays and a coming SpaceX raise (~$50B within 6 months) are signals to watch; weak demand there would be a warning.

calls.instrument_quoted: AI trade / stock market (no level quoted)
calls.condition: Until companies become unable to raise capital
calls.reason: Market is a bubble but the capital window has not closed (CoreWeave debt oversubscribed), so he stays bullish.
calls.quote: my opinion is you should buy it cuz the bubble ain't over yet.

calls.reason: About $18B of bills due within 12 months vs ~$10.5B cash and receivables; keeps raising debt because losses are large.
calls.quote: In other words, morons are still buying this trash, which means the bubble and party is still going.

calls.reason: Current bills ($95.8B) exceed cash and short-term investments ($76.8B); relies on ~$14.4B quarterly FCF. He holds exposure.
calls.quote: this is getting a little tighter here.

notes: No date stated; listing date used. 'Cororeweave' = CoreWeave (CRWV). Aura/Oura ring IPO criticized but no ticker. MSFT view is a balance-sheet caution, not a sell call.
